description: Implementation of the egl::Device class, representing an abstract graphics device, including creation, validation, extension management, and attribute retrieval.

classes.name: Device
classes.description: Represents an abstract graphics device, managing extensions, attributes, and validation.

methods.name: CreateDevice
methods.description: Factory method to create a new Device instance based on device type and native device handle.

methods.name: IsValidDevice
methods.description: Checks if a given Device instance is valid and registered.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets a label for the device.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the label of the device.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute value from the device implementation.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the device.

methods.name: initDeviceExtensions
methods.description: Generates and stores the device's extension string.
